answer: Each new identity earns an opal hue by doing attested work in a fresh domain, listed on a public opal board. The nth identity funded from one wallet must prove real work in n distinct domains — the 1st in one, the 10th in ten — each domain needing one client-signed receipt plus a 4 POA ember bond burned if the receipt is fake, so ten fakes need 55 proofs and 220 POA in bonds. A vertex check ties each proof to a real client, so a fake reusing one domain's work across clones is exposed at once.
